interpretation: The new six trials use three distinct predeclared sourceXY/yaw combinations per robot. All started trials, including incomplete physical failures, remain in denominator. Same object-frame feedback and task code is reused by changing the robot adapter; this does not establish arbitrary-pose robustness, learned-policy/weight transfer, or OPD/ICL adaptation. The originalA03Ffunctional result and its6reusedtraining episodes remain separate.
verifier_boundary: Finite state plus no scopepenetration is insufficient to certify task progress. Recorded teacherlabels from a failedpickup episode are not successful demonstrations; this study trains no weights, and preserves such failures for diagnosis rather than positive-data admission.

video_render.selection: All six fixed new recipes, including failed partial trajectories with explicitly labeled terminal holds; diagnostic SPH particle display, no new physics.
video_render.mapping_provenance: Reconstructed deterministically from preserved timestamp arrays after renderer report-only NumPy bool serialization failure; no frames rerendered.

root_readback.checked: All six terminal native receipts and fixed-condition summary; both video keyframes; producer full-decode receipt and metadata repair. No rerun of original F admission audit.
